equity_bridge.item: FY2025 final dividend payable at 2026-06-30 (HK$0.69/share, RMB2,584m), paid July 2026
equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 interim Note 18; cash at 30 June still contained it, the October price does not

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case forward path (FY2026-FY2030 average); historical CAGRs are a post-IPO scale-up from losses and are not a forward proxy
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR 25.9% vs revenue 14.9% diverges >30%: equity compounded from a loss-scarred base (FY2022 RMB39.8bn after RMB-224bn accumulated losses) and is not a growth proxy. EPS and 5-yr equity CAGRs are undefined (negative start values: FY2020 loss RMB-116.6bn incl. preferred-share fair-value charges; FY2022 EPS -3.22). Owner-FCF CAGR undefined (FY2022 negative); the FY2023-FY2025 owner FCF series is 12.1bn -> 18.6bn -> 8.3bn, the FY2025 drop being the start of the AI capex step-up, so reported-vs-owner divergence is capex-driven, not SBC-driven (SBC fell from 6.6% of revenue FY2022 to 1.85% FY2025).
historical_growth.notes: Revenue growth decelerated from +12.5% FY2025 to +2.4% H1 FY2026 (+1.4% in Q2): live streaming -13.5% YoY in Q2, online marketing +4.4%, other services (e-commerce + Kling AI) +18.5%. Kling AI revenue exceeded RMB850m in Q2 FY2026 (~RMB3.4bn annualised). DAU 412m, MAU 785m -- user growth is single-digit; growth is monetisation and Kling.

scenario_narratives.base: Kuaishou is a mature 412m-DAU platform whose growth has slowed to low single digits: live-streaming tipping (25% of revenue) is shrinking ~10-13% a year under a 'healthy ecosystem' regime, online marketing (58%) grows 4-5% in a soft Chinese ad market, and other services (e-commerce commissions on RMB1.6tn GMV plus Kling AI) grow high-teens. Revenue +2.5% FY2026, recovering to 4-5% FY2027-29 as live streaming bottoms and Kling (RMB850m+ in Q2, roughly doubling YoY) becomes a RMB10bn+ business, fading to 3% nominal. Adjusted EBITDA margin dips to 16.5% in FY2026 on R&D and compute costs, then rebuilds to 19.5% (flat on FY2025) by FY2032. The AI capex step-up (RMB~30bn FY2026, 20% of revenue) fades to 8% over six years, leaving an owner-FCF margin of ~6% at maturity. ~RMB94bn of net cash and WMPs (HK$25/share) is added at face.
scenario_narratives.bull: Kling AI becomes the global leader in commercial video generation and a multi-billion-RMB, high-margin business; AI-generated marketing material and smart-bidding lift online marketing back to high-single-digit growth; e-commerce take-rate and pan-shelf GMV keep compounding; live streaming stabilises after the FY2026 reset. Revenue 5% -> 9% -> fading to 3.5% terminal, adjusted EBITDA margin expands to 24% on operating leverage over a fixed content/R&D base, capex normalises to 7% of revenue, terminal growth 3%. Buybacks (RMB2.9bn FY2025) and the FY2025 dividend become a sustained capital-return programme on top of the cash pile.
scenario_narratives.bear: The H2 FY2026 'cautious' outlook is the start of a structural decline: live-streaming regulation and user migration to Douyin/WeChat Video pull revenue down 3% and 2% in FY2026-27 before stalling at 1-2% growth; the ad market stays weak and share is lost to larger reach platforms; Kling is out-competed by ByteDance/Google video models and never covers its compute cost, so AI capex only fades to 8% of revenue (vs a 14-15% EBITDA margin) and ex-ROU D&A rises to 7.5%. Owner FCF is negative for the first three years and only ~2% of revenue at maturity; the valuation collapses toward the net cash pile, which itself carries WMP credit and onshore-remittance risk not modelled here. Terminal growth 2%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF on a strict basis: SBC expensed, share count flat, lease payments charged as operating cost, all investment income stripped from the flows and its source assets (cash, time deposits, wealth-management products) added once to the bridge at carrying value. The value is roughly 80% cash pile and 20% operating business at the current price, so the thesis is about whether the operating business is worth more than the ~HK$5/share the market assigns to it after the AI capex cycle -- not about the cash, which is the floor.
key_risks_to_valuation: Live-streaming revenue (25% of FY2025 revenue) is in structural decline (-13.5% YoY in Q2 FY2026) under content-governance tightening; a faster decline is the bear path.
AI/Kling capex step-up (RMB17.9bn in H1 FY2026 alone vs RMB14.9bn in all of FY2025) may not fade as modelled; every 1pp of permanent capex/revenue is ~RMB1.5bn/yr of owner FCF.
Competition from Douyin (ByteDance) and WeChat Video Channels for ad budgets and e-commerce GMV; online marketing growth has already slowed from ~20% to ~4%.
RMB82.8bn of the cash pile is in non-guaranteed bank wealth-management products (RMB27bn non-current); taken at carrying value with no haircut.
Cash tax rate is held at 8-10% near term on HNTE preferential rates, R&D super-deductions and deferred-tax-asset recognition; a faster ramp to 25% statutory would cut owner FCF by ~RMB1-2bn/yr.
HKD/CNY rate and China regulatory/VIE/delisting risk are carried in a 10% CNY WACC; dividend repatriation attracts 5-10% withholding tax not deducted from the cash pile.

Recurring regulatory penalties (CAC RMB119m Feb-2026 content-moderation fine, SAMR RMB26.7m Jan-2026 e-commerce fine, three in six months) signal governance enforcement risk whose timing and scale are not modelled beyond the bear revenue path.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (HKEX regular close); 52-week range HK$28.52-85.20
data_sources.fx: Yahoo Finance HKDCNY=X and CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-09/11; see inputs.fx_note
data_sources.financials: research/1024.HK/Reports/1024.HK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics, millions CNY) and the FY2025 annual report / H1 FY2026 interim report in research/1024.HK/Extracted (balance sheet, Notes 7/8 other gains, Note 10 finance income, Note 12 income tax, Note 14 FVTPL, Note 18 dividends, diluted-EPS note)
data_sources.qualitative: research/1024.HK/Reports/1024.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-12) and the FY2025 annual / H1 FY2026 interim MD&A (business review and outlook)

inputs.share_count_basis: 4,326.9m shares in issue at 2026-06-30 (interim report, share capital note) plus 61m dilutive options/RSUs (Q2 FY2026 diluted-EPS denominator 4,374m vs 4,313m basic). Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows, so diluting the count as well would charge it twice. Buybacks (RMB2.9bn FY2025, RMB1.3bn H1 FY2026, 12.3m shares in July 2026) fund the flat count.
inputs.cash_composition: 2026-06-30, RMB m: cash and equivalents 11,696 + short-term time deposits 12,358 + long-term time deposits 14,291 + wealth-management products at FVTPL 82,750 (current 55,634 + non-current 27,116; Note 14) = 121,095. This is the company's own 'total available funds' basis (RMB121.3bn incl. restricted cash) and is BROADER than the Metrics.csv Cash column (80,407 = cash + ST deposits + all current FVTPL) because the matching-asset rule requires the WMP pile to enter the bridge once its RMB2.46bn/yr of fair-value gains are stripped from EBITDA. Equity investments in listed/unlisted entities (~RMB3.2bn) and restricted cash are EXCLUDED and their gains stripped too.
inputs.total_debt_composition: 2026-06-30 borrowings only: non-current 14,792 (incl. USD1.5bn + RMB3.5bn senior notes issued Jan-2026) + current 12,570 = 27,362. Lease liabilities (11,672) excluded under lease treatment B. The RMB2,584m FY2025 final dividend payable at 30 June (paid July 2026) is deducted in equity_bridge.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report, adjusted-net-profit reconciliation and cash-flow statement, 'Share-based compensation expenses' RMB2,640m (2,630 equity-settled). No cash taxes on net-share settlement disclosed (EquityAwardTaxes = 0), so no separate add.
inputs.fx_note: Model currency CNY -> quote currency HKD at 1 CNY = 1.1747 HKD (Yahoo HKDCNY=X 0.8513 inverted, 2026-10-11; CNYHKD=X printed 1.1721 on 2026-10-09). fx_rate is model->quote as the Drivers contract requires. No dual listing exists for a parity check; cross-check: the FY2025 final dividend of HK$0.69/share x 4.33bn shares = HK$3.0bn, booked as RMB2,584m, implies 1.16 HKD/CNY at the June-2026 declaration date, consistent with the rate used.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in the flows' currency (CNY): China 10-yr CGB ~1.8% risk-free; China equity risk premium incl. country/regulatory premium ~6.5-7%; beta ~1.2 for a Chinese consumer-internet platform. Cost of equity ~10%; the RMB2.45%-4.75% senior notes are too small (RMB27bn vs ~RMB130bn market cap) to pull the blend down materially. 10.0% WACC used in ALL three scenarios -- risk is carried in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked in the discount rate (adaptations section f).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment B, leases as operating cost: full lease cash payment (principal + interest, RMB3,823m FY2025 = 2.68% of revenue; RMB1,919m H1 FY2026 = 2.77%) charged inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path at 2.9%; lease liabilities (RMB11,672m) EXCLUDED from net debt; da_pct_path is D&A EX right-of-use depreciation (FY2025: PP&E 3,903 + intangibles 77 = 3,980, 2.8% of revenue; H1 FY2026: 3,141 = 4.5%) so the lease is not charged twice in cash-tax EBIT.
inputs.nci_treatment: Non-controlling interests RMB34m on RMB82bn equity, NCI profit share RMB8m in H1 FY2026 -- immaterial; flows are taken as attributable with no bridge deduction.
inputs.ebitda_basis: ebitda_margin_path is ADJUSTED EBITDA ex investment gains: operating profit + D&A (all of it, incl. ROU) + SBC, MINUS net fair-value gains on FVTPL assets (WMPs and listed/unlisted investments, Note 7/8). FY2025: 20,637 + 7,195 + 2,640 - 3,077 = 27,395 = 19.2%. H1 FY2026: 7,352 + 4,785 + 1,311 - 1,769 = 11,679 = 16.9%. Ties to company adjusted EBITDA less WMP gains (29,839 - 2,460 = 27,379 FY2025). Interest income from bank deposits (RMB962m) sits below operating profit and is not in this EBITDA; the RMB800m 'interest income received' in OCF is stripped from last_fcf.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing: operating company, consumer internet / marketplace) with the non-US adaptations: CNY-built WACC, CNY statements vs HKD quote (fx_rate), lease treatment B, matching-asset rule for the RMB121bn cash + WMP pile. First valuation of this ticker; scenario axes are drawn from the FY2025 annual and H1 FY2026 interim MD&A and cross-checked against 1024.HK_Analysis.json (bull: Kling second curve, AI ad efficiency, capital returns; bear: broad deceleration, live-streaming structural decline, AI opex/capex margin squeeze, recurring CAC/SAMR penalties, weak consumer). Post-Q2 FY2026 sell-side consensus target ~HK$50.6 (range HK$27.6-102) per the Analysis JSON; the weighted IV lands on consensus and the bear sits below the lowest street target. Anchors: price is the 2026-10-09 HKEX regular close (not after-hours); balance sheet and share count are 2026-06-30. Owner FCF FY2025 = 11,774 reported - 2,640 SBC - 800 interest = 8,334 (5.8% of revenue). H1 FY2026 reported FCF was -8,897 because capex spiked to RMB17.9bn (Q1 12.0bn, Q2 5.9bn) on AI/Kling compute -- treated as a step-up that fades over 4-5 years, not a run-rate, and matched by a rising ex-ROU D&A path. Working capital: payables + other payables + advances (RMB74.6bn) dwarf receivables (7.8bn), so growth releases cash: wc_capture_pct +8% of the revenue change (and consumes cash in the bear decline). Cash tax: FY2025 paid RMB1,392m on ~RMB17bn EBIT (8%) thanks to HNTE 15% rates, R&D super-deduction and recognition of previously unrecognised deferred tax assets; ramped to 18% (15% HNTE blended with 25% entities and 5-10% WHT on remittance). Net cash of RMB93.7bn (after the dividend-payable deduction) is ~HK$25/share, i.e. ~83% of the HK$30.1 price; the valuation is therefore dominated by the cash pile and the bear case is bounded by it. WMPs are bank wealth-management products whose returns are not guaranteed -- taken at carrying value, consistent with the company's available-funds disclosure.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 +2.5% matches the H1 run-rate (+2.4%) and management's explicitly cautious H2 outlook; live-streaming decline (25% of revenue, -13% YoY) offsets ad growth (+4-5%) and Kling (+100%+). Recovers to 4-5% FY2027-FY2029 as live streaming stabilises and Kling scales, then fades to 3% nominal by FY2033.
base.margin_rationale: Adjusted EBITDA margin ex investment gains fell from 19.2% FY2025 to 16.9% H1 FY2026 on R&D +22% and server/bandwidth costs; base holds FY2026 at 16.5%, then rebuilds 0.5pp/yr to 19.5% by FY2032 (flat on FY2025) as Kling moves to profitability and S&M discipline (29.6% of revenue FY2025, down from 32.4%) continues.
base.capex_rationale: FY2026 capex ~RMB29-30bn (H1 17.9bn + ~11.8bn H2 at the Q2 run-rate) = 20% of revenue; fades to 8% by FY2032 -- still ~2x the pre-AI level (4.3% FY2023, 6.4% FY2024) to carry Kling inference compute. Ex-ROU D&A rises from 4.5% to 7% behind it (PP&E 22.9bn -> 34.1bn in six months).

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 18x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25%: management is explicitly cautious on the short-term outlook, Q2 FY2026 revenue grew only 1.4% with the live-streaming line shrinking 13.5%, attributable profit fell 36% in Q2, and the RMB18bn H1 capex step-up has no demonstrated return yet; the share price has fallen from HK$85 to HK$30 in twelve months, which signals the market is pricing a regime change rather than a cyclical dip. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs two independent things to go right -- Kling winning a global AI-video race against ByteDance/Google and a Chinese ad-market recovery. Base 50%.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
